messages.text: Good morning sir, greetings from Defence Careers Consultancy.

text: We have a high paying part-time consultancy role for serving and retired officers:

messages.text: What kind of work is it?
Very simple sir. Our foreign clients want analysis reports on Indian defence equipment and deployments.
As a sample, please share which radars and missile systems are deployed in your old sector and the unit locations.
I can't share that, it is classified.
Sir it is only for research, nobody will know. Even old troop strength figures will do. We pay in advance.
